title: Northwatch Research Station
intent: A compact ring of insulated prefabs surrounds a flagged service court. A heated tunnel links lab, dormitory and generator while the instrument array remains an exposed optional branch.

staging.logistics: Van is already staged on a prepared roadhead/service apron through expedition logistics. Travel to this remote region is a campaign transition; no new vehicle, ferry or flight gameplay is assumed.

circulation: Flagged court is the visual reference; return routes remain traversable in all allowed weather. Heated tunnel gives an interior alternative rather than a mandatory long snow crossing. Array is visible from the radio room and has a near shelter.
systems: Outdoor freezing is weather, never automatic paranormal evidence. Calibrated inside/outside baselines, generator vibration and ventilation must preserve tool usefulness. Snow visuals may not erase paths or alter collision per client.
campaign: Observation logs and contradictory transmissions support the remote campaign arc. Van deployment is a pre-established station logistics arrangement; this plan creates no polar driving minigame.
refine: Verify physical prefabs and tunnel fire/vent separation with primary station references before detailed construction.
Snowdrift barriers must leave two clear loops and one readable retreat route at every allowed condition.
Station expansion and radio plot remain design-only until persistence and legal events exist.
sources: https://www.bas.ac.uk/project/signy-research-station-modernisation/ (text inspected 2026-10-21: separate house, stores and generator functions only; fictional station geometry authored)
